# LX03 C-LIGHT:1 owner encoded corpus

Generated by `tests/wire.rs` against real `wire::Service` and LX02 `Authority`, not
surface simulation. `commands.json` contains requests and exact provider replies;
`refusals.json` additionally records injected logical tick and complete prior/after
inventory. Identical cached replies deliberately retain their original revision.
Consumers must not regress their newer complete snapshot when receiving them.

Owner schema and page assembly algorithm: docs/notes/0029-lighting-wire.md.
Aggregate snapshot page `chunk` text is joined by page index before JSON parsing.
Requests use canonical counter strings. The production regression test generates
current real outcomes and compares every JSON value to these files. Regenerate only
explicitly: LUX_GENERATE_CORPUS=1 cargo +1.97.1 test --locked -j1 --test wire.
Run under the shared host build lock, incremental=0, pinned Rust1.97.1.

Provenance: shr-lux HEAD ba4ccd92656e6d2a3cbc6424cdc2a017d3e4f14d plus exact
uncommitted checkpoint-LX03.json source hashes retained by coordinator. Contract
